tasks.answer: DeleteDiscussion uses ConfirmationDialog from @/components/ui/dialog with icon='danger', title, body, triggerButton and confirmButton. Only title, triggerButton and confirmButton are required; body is optional.

LoginForm uses Input. The Form render prop exposes react-hook-form's register; fields bind via registration={register('email')} and registration={register('password')}, with error={formState.errors[...]}. Input spreads the registration object onto the native <input>, and registration is its only required custom prop.

DiscussionsList passes pagination={{ totalPages, currentPage, rootUrl }} to Table, which renders TablePagination. TablePagination requires totalPages (number), currentPage (number), and rootUrl (string). The table barrel @/components/ui/table exports Table, not TablePagination, so the direct pagination path is shown.
MDPreview takes the Markdown text as value: string, parses it with marked, sanitizes the HTML with DOMPurify, and renders it via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
CreateDiscussion wraps its FormDrawer in Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}, so it requires the ADMIN role. It takes no props.

notes: No component-catalog CLI or catalog JSON was used. Used find/grep only to locate candidates, then read every listed file in full with the read tool. commands is 0 by task convention (zero catalog commands). Uncertainty is limited to Task 3: TablePagination is rendered by Table via its pagination prop but is not re-exported from the @/components/ui/table barrel, so the direct path @/components/ui/table/pagination is recorded.
